name: Orca Whirlpools

actions.label: Withdraw all
actions.description: Remove all liquidity from the selected position, collect fees and rewards, then close the position and burn its NFT.

supported: Single-position NFTs (SPL Token or Token-2022) held by the connected wallet in any token account; pool and reward tokens are ordinary SPL Token or the listed Token-2022 extensions; WSOL stays wrapped

token2022.receipt: spendable net amount after per-transfer, epoch-specific fees; withheld fees are excluded

liquidityMinimums: token_min_a and token_min_b are 0; see docs/orca-operations.md
excluded: position token accounts with another close authority
